assets.name: russia-landscape
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural / editorial collage. Asset type: very wide website hero background, approximately 2:1 landscape, at least 1536 pixels wide. Create a fictional artistic regional collage of Russia, not evidence of actual KUNAKI projects. Vintage photographic newspaper-cutout aesthetic, muted forest green, slate blue, warm cream and small ochre accents, fine halftone grain, realistic archival photo textures and rough torn light paper edges. Build a coherent spacious panorama from overlapping cut photographic fragments of multiple Russian regions: on the LEFT birch branches, rocky blue Lake Baikal shore and a small traditional Northern Russian wooden house; on the RIGHT the broad Volga river, soft wooded Ural hills, a small recognisable Kazan old-city architectural silhouette including a mosque dome and minarets; along the LOWER edge a small Saint Petersburg raised drawbridge and a Far Eastern rocky sea shore; a modest distant Altai snowy ridge is optional and must not dominate. The UPPER CENTRAL HALF must remain very LIGHT and EMPTY, pale cream paper or quiet pale sky for an HTML heading and a separate animated sun. Place richer visual pieces mostly around left, right and bottom. No sun, no circular light disk, no sun rays, no hands, no people, no text, no typography, no logos, no interface, no flags, no political symbolism or slogans, no Caucasian defensive towers or horsemen, no watermark. High-end tactile mixed-media print, sophisticated rather than childish, authentic photographic geographic fragments, uneven torn paper silhouettes.

assets.name: hands-connection
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural / transparent editorial cutout. Asset type: isolated very wide pair of reaching hands for a website animation; landscape 2:1 or 3:2. Create a fictional artistic human-support image, not evidence of an actual KUNAKI project. ONLY two realistic adult hands and forearms on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, with alpha outside the cutout. A woman's forearm enters from the LEFT image boundary in a simple knitted or linen sleeve without ethnic ornament; her hand is palm down and her fingers gently reach to the right. A man's forearm enters from the RIGHT image boundary in a plain dark jacket sleeve; his open supporting palm faces UP and his fingers extend LEFT. The woman's fingertips gently touch and rest in the man's open palm, a clear gesture of support. Put the actual touching point at PRECISELY the horizontal midpoint, around 50 percent image width. Both forearms extend all the way to the side boundaries. Correct human anatomy, five fingers on each hand, no extra hands, no rings or jewellery. Photorealistic BLACK AND WHITE archival photograph cut from old newsprint, fine halftone dots, subtle grain, a thin irregular warm-white torn-paper outline just around each hand-and-sleeve silhouette. Do not add a rectangular white backing: everything outside the shaped newspaper cutouts is fully transparent. No faces, bodies, backdrop, landscape, text, logos, watermarks, political/religious gestures. These two hands are intended to be split into left and right halves in code and animated from separated positions into this exact final touching pose, so composition and contact at the midpoint are essential.
